text: I just feel like nobody really cares if I show up or not.
Even when I'm in a room full of people, I feel completely disconnected and alone.
My friends never reach out to me first. I don't think I matter to them.
It's not that I want to be alone, but I just don't fit in anywhere.
I don't have any real friends, just acquaintances who wouldn't notice if I disappeared.
I used to have a great group of friends, but now I don't talk to anyone for weeks.
A few years ago I was the life of the party. Today, I'm completely isolated.
Oh yeah, I'm super popular. My phone rings all the time... just kidding, it's a ghost town.
Sure, everyone loves having me around. That's why I spend every weekend staring at the wall.
My mom always said, 'You're just destined to be a loner.'
When my ex left, they told me 'No one will ever truly connect with you.'
No matter how hard I try, my coworkers just ignore me.
I feel like a total outcast. Though I guess my dog loves me.
I could vanish tomorrow and it would take weeks for anyone to notice.
I'm always the odd one out. I don't belong here.
Everyone else seems to have their group. I'm just floating on the outside.
I feel totally alienated from my own family.
There's a glass wall between me and the rest of the world.
I don't feel connected to anyone anymore.
I'm surrounded by people but I've never felt more alone.
